title: bytes.format puts the thousands separator into the decimal part
prompt: Our bytes.format() in index.js mangles numbers when the thousandsSeparator option is used together with decimal places: the separator is also inserted inside the fractional digits. For example, formatting 1005.1005 KB with decimalPlaces 4 and thousandsSeparator '_' should give '1_005.1005kb', but the digits after the decimal point get separators too. Please fix it so the separator only affects the integer part.
